evals.prompt: Run a controlled comparison while helping me write a short product announcement for existing customers. Use the assignment as the one implicit objective, leave any .writing/goals.md file untouched, and log every process switch in the trace.
evals.expected_output: The run uses the no-goal-network comparison skill, keeps the assignment, draft, memory, and trace state, leaves goals.md unchanged, and reports process decisions with evidence and uncertainty.
expectations: Treats the assignment as the implicit objective and does not create hierarchical goal identifiers (IDs).
Leaves .writing/goals.md untouched, including when a planning delegation proposes a goal change.
Continues to log process switches with the responsible actor, decision, evidence, and uncertainty.
